The data are two public ephemeris sources in different formats for the same physical problem. Independent calculations agree on the 2,792 source-row and horizon combinations and the ordinary exact solver is strongest. Checking 620 published rows at the first horizon found five decisions that would pass under assumed zero covariance but depend on covariance. Later comparative evidence is pending. The models cannot fix a physically absent cross-correlation or establish operating outcomes. No dedicated evaluator, stronger external account/runtime, GPU, paid data or telescopes are authorized. Choose the next concrete independent experiment with existing public primary records. Consider (1) recover fitted covariance or original timings and hold out new observations, (2) cross-domain construction with a practical existing alternative, (3) pause and retain this exact asset. Require a meaningful result beyond indexing another table.

findings: The proposal calls a second file format a new domain; both sources are the same astronomy domain.
It calls the first BJD TDB anchor seconds and describes the time basis as hours. BJD TDB anchors are days.
Recomputing the same Table 8 case cannot recover unreported fitted covariance or qualify unseen observation coverage.
Several fields ended mid-sentence even though the JSON shape was accepted.

research_gate.acceptance: Freeze data by availability date and signed source release. Require calibrated timing coverage and materially fewer minutes reserved for the same coverage under the same telescope constraints. Separate ephemerides with nonlinearity or missing/unverified covariance. Use out-of-sample timing observations; no observing appointment or cost claim from a simulation.
research_gate.control: Original forecast, conventional weighted least-squares refit with full covariance, and wide-coverage scheduling within the same time budget.
research_gate.objective: Determine whether missing covariance can be recovered from released original transit times and improve a real decision on prospectively held-out transit observations.

selection_grounding: Public operating evidence and subsequent scientific assessment. The next test is not a completed result.
